experiment: Frozen Stage239 multi-event temporal list-order resolver replay

input.question_scope: All 133 Stage239 temporal-reasoning answers with frozen selected Top-20 evidence.
input.method: Rebuild the list from event audit items only when every event has a source-validated disjoint date interval; rejudge changed answers only.

resolved_rows.question: What is the order of the three trips I took in the past three months, from earliest to latest?
resolved_rows.ground_truth_answer: I went on a day hike to Muir Woods National Monument with my family, then I went on a road trip with friends to Big Sur and Monterey, and finally I started my solo camping trip to Yosemite National Park.
resolved_rows.baseline_answer: Muir Woods day hike → Big Sur and Monterey road trip → Yosemite solo camping trip
resolved_rows.candidate_answer:
1. Day hike to Muir Woods National Monument
2. Road trip to Big Sur and Monterey
3. Solo camping trip to Yosemite National Park

resolved_rows.question: What is the order of airlines I flew with from earliest to latest before today?
resolved_rows.baseline_answer: JetBlue → United Airlines → American Airlines. The evidence does not establish that the Boston–Atlanta flight was on Delta, so Delta cannot be placed in the order of airlines you flew with.
resolved_rows.candidate_answer:
1. JetBlue red-eye flight from San Francisco to Boston
2. Delta round-trip flight from Boston to Atlanta
3. United Airlines flight from Boston to Chicago
4. American Airlines flight from New York to Los Angeles

decision: Positive isolated pilot with one correction and zero regressions. Keep the resolver opt-in; run a fresh full 500-question Top-20 candidate before recommending it.
